Assessment.content: Viral upper respiratory infection versus early influenza-like illness for 4 days with sore throat (improving), congestion and rhinorrhea, dry cough, myalgias, night sweats, initial fever, and mild dyspnea on exertion only.

Plan_of_Care.content: Supportive care recommended for viral URI or influenza-like illness.
Supportive care includes rest and fluids/hydration.
Continue paracetamol and ibuprofen as needed.
Recommend 1–2 days off work if able.
